verses.sloka: पृष्ट्वा तु कुशलम् तत्र परस्पर समागमे ।कथाअन्ते सुमतिः वाक्यम् व्याजहार महामुनिम् ॥१-४८-१॥
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭvā tu kuśalam tatra paraspara samāgame ।kathāante sumatiḥ vākyam vyājahāra mahāmunim ॥1-48-1॥

translations.english: Getting together they enquired one another's health. And then Sumati spoke to the great ascetic (Viswamitra).

verses.sloka: इमौ कुमारौ भद्रम् ते देव तुल्य पराक्रमौ ।गज सिंह गती वीरौ शार्दूल वृषभ उपमौ ॥१-४८-२॥
verses.transliteration: imau kumārau bhadram te deva tulya parākramau ।gaja siṁha gatī vīrau śārdūla vṛṣabha upamau ॥1-48-2॥

translations.english: "O Sage, wish you well Who are these two youths who seem to possess the prowess of celestial beings. They walk with the gait of an elephant or a lion. They are courageous like tiger or a bull. Their large eyes are like lotuspetals. They are armed with scimitars, bows and quivers. They are young and handsome like Aswinikumaras dropped from heaven casually. Whose sons are they? How did they come here on foot? With what purpose?
translations.hindi: है भगवन्‌ ! तुम्हारे बलवान्‌ पुत्रों ने मेरे पुत्रों को मार डाला है। अतः मैं इन्द्र का मारने वाला पुत्र चाहती हूँ, भले ही वह बड़ी तपस्या करने पर ही क्‍यों न प्राप्त हो

verses.sloka: पद्म पत्र विशालाक्षौ खड्ग तूणी धनुर् धरौ ।अश्विनौ इव रूपेण समुपस्थित यौवनौ ॥१-४८-३॥
verses.transliteration: padma patra viśālākṣau khaḍga tūṇī dhanur dharau ।aśvinau iva rūpeṇa samupasthita yauvanau ॥1-48-3॥

translations.english: "O Sage, wish you well Who are these two youths who seem to possess the prowess of celestial beings. They walk with the gait of an elephant or a lion. They are courageous like tiger or a bull. Their large eyes are like lotuspetals. They are armed with scimitars, bows and quivers. They are young and handsome like Aswinikumaras dropped from heaven casually. Whose sons are they? How did they come here on foot? With what purpose?
translations.hindi: मैं तपस्या करूँगी। आप मुझे ऐसा गर्भ दीजिए जिसमें बल- चान्‌ , महाविजयी, दृढ़ बुद्धि वाला, समदर्शी

verses.sloka: यदृच्छया एव गाम् प्राप्तौ देवलोकात् इव अमरौ ।कथम् पद्भ्याम् इह प्राप्तौ किम् अर्थम् कस्य वा मुने ॥१-४८-४॥
verses.transliteration: yadṛcchayā eva gām prāptau devalokāt iva amarau ।katham padbhyām iha prāptau kim artham kasya vā mune ॥1-48-4॥

translations.english: "O Sage, wish you well Who are these two youths who seem to possess the prowess of celestial beings. They walk with the gait of an elephant or a lion. They are courageous like tiger or a bull. Their large eyes are like lotuspetals. They are armed with scimitars, bows and quivers. They are young and handsome like Aswinikumaras dropped from heaven casually. Whose sons are they? How did they come here on foot? With what purpose?
translations.hindi: तीनों लोकों का स्वामी और इन्द्र को मारने वाला पुत्र जन्मे । तब दिति के यह वचन सुन, मरीचसुत कश्यप जी,

verses.sloka: भूषयन्तौ इमम् देशम् चन्द्र सूर्यौ इव अंबरम् ।परस्परेण सदृशौ प्रमाण इन्गित चेष्टितैः ॥१-४८-५॥
verses.transliteration: bhūṣayantau imam deśam candra sūryau iva aṁbaram ।paraspareṇa sadṛśau pramāṇa ingita ceṣṭitaiḥ ॥1-48-5॥

translations.english: O Great ascetic they resemble each other in personality, expression and gestures. They adorn this land like Sun and moon in the sky holding excellent weapons. These heroes have trodden paths difficult to traverse. For what purpose have they come? I want to hear clearly".
translations.hindi: जो बड़े तेजस्वी थे, अत्यन्त दुखी दिति से बोले- तेरा- कल्याण हो और जैसा तू चाहती है, वैसा ही दी । हे तपोधने ! तू. पवित्र हो

verses.sloka: किम् अर्थम् च नर श्रेष्ठौ सम्प्राप्तौ दुर्गमे पथि ।वर आयुध धरौ वीरौ श्रोतुम् इच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥१-४८-६॥
verses.transliteration: kim artham ca nara śreṣṭhau samprāptau durgame pathi ।vara āyudha dharau vīrau śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ ॥1-48-6॥

translations.english: O Great ascetic they resemble each other in personality, expression and gestures. They adorn this land like Sun and moon in the sky holding excellent weapons. These heroes have trodden paths difficult to traverse. For what purpose have they come? I want to hear clearly".
translations.hindi: तू ऐसा पुत्र जनेगी जो युद्ध में इन्द्र को मारने वाला होगा | किन्तु यह तभी होगा, जब तू पूरे एक हजार वर्षों तक पवित्रता से रहेगी

verses.sloka: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा यथा वृत्तम् न्यवेदयत् ।सिद्ध आश्रम निवासम् च राक्षसानाम् वधम् तथा ॥१-४८-७॥
verses.transliteration: tasya tad vacanam śrutvā yathā vṛttam nyavedayat ।siddha āśrama nivāsam ca rākṣasānām vadham tathā ॥1-48-7॥

translations.english: On hearing his words, he (Viswamitra) related all about their stay at Siddhashrama and the slaying of rakshasas.
translations.hindi: मेरे अनुग्रह से तीनों लोकों का स्वामी पुत्र तेरे उत्पन्न होगा ।. इस प्रकार कह और दिति को आश्वासन दे और उसऊा पेट हाथ से सुहरा कर तथा उसे आशीर्वाद दे कश्यप जी तपस्या करने चले गए | हे पुरुषोत्तम ! उनके जाने के बाद दिति बहुत प्रसन्न हुई

verses.sloka: विश्वामित्र वचः श्रुत्वा राजा परम विस्मितः ॥१-४८-८॥
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitra vacaḥ śrutvā rājā parama vismitaḥ ॥1-48-8॥

translations.english: After hearing Viswamitra, the king (Sumati) got exceedingly delighted and extended hospitality in accordance with tradition to the highly valiant sons of Dasaratha, the distinguished guests worthy of honour.

verses.sloka: च्अतिथी परमौ प्राप्तम् पुत्रौ दशरथस्य तौ ।पूजयामास विधिवत् सत्कार अर्हौ महाबलौ ॥१-४८-९॥
verses.transliteration: catithī paramau prāptam putrau daśarathasya tau ।pūjayāmāsa vidhivat satkāra arhau mahābalau ॥1-48-9॥

translations.english: The descendants of Raghu (Rama and Lakshmana) having received great honour from Sumati, stayed there one night and thereafter set out for Mithila.

verses.sloka: ततः परम सत्कारम् सुमतेः प्राप्य राघवौ ।उष्य तत्र निशाम् एकाम् जग्मतुः मिथिलाम् ततः ॥१-४८-१०॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ parama satkāram sumateḥ prāpya rāghavau ।uṣya tatra niśām ekām jagmatuḥ mithilām tataḥ ॥1-48-10॥

translations.english: All the ascetics, having seen that auspicious city of Janaka worshipfully admired Mithila saying, 'Excellent, Excellent'

verses.sloka: ताम् दृष्ट्वा मुनयः सर्वे जनकस्य पुरीम् शुभाम् ।साधु साधु इति शंसन्तो मिथिलाम् समपूजयन् ॥१-४८-११॥
verses.transliteration: tām dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ sarve janakasya purīm śubhām ।sādhu sādhu iti śaṁsanto mithilām samapūjayan ॥1-48-11॥

translations.english: At the sight of an old uninhabited, beautiful and desolate hermitage in a grove near Mithila, the descendant of the Raghus enquired of the foremost among the ascetics (Viswamitra):

verses.sloka: मिथिल उपवने तत्र आश्रमम् दृश्य राघवः ।पुराणम् निर्जनम् रम्यम् पप्रच्छ मुनि पुंगवम् ॥१-४८-१२॥
verses.transliteration: mithila upavane tatra āśramam dṛśya rāghavaḥ ।purāṇam nirjanam ramyam papraccha muni puṁgavam ॥1-48-12॥

translations.english: "O Venerable one I wish to know why this auspicios looking hermitage was deserted by ascetics? To whom did this belong in the past."

verses.sloka: इदम् आश्रम संकाशम् किम् नु इदम् मुनि वर्जितम् ।श्रोतुम् इच्छामि भगवन् कस्य अयम् पूर्व आश्रमः ॥१-४८-१३॥
verses.transliteration: idam āśrama saṁkāśam kim nu idam muni varjitam ।śrotum icchāmi bhagavan kasya ayam pūrva āśramaḥ ॥1-48-13॥

translations.english: Eloquent and brilliant Viswamitra, replied to the descendant of the Raghus saying:
translations.hindi: तब दिति ने इन्द्र से परम हृषित होकर कहा है इन्द्र !. तुम्हारे पिता ने मुझे माँगने पर एक हजार वर्ष बीतने पर एक पुत्र होने गी वर दिया है। सो अब केवल दस वर्षे और शेष रह गए है । सो इसके बाद तुम ( अपने;) भाई को देखोगे । यद्यपि मैं उसे तुम्हें जीतने के लिए. उत्पन्न करना चाहती हुँ

verses.sloka: तत् श्रुता राघवेण उक्तम् वाक्यम् वाक्य विशारदः ।प्रति उवाच महातेजा विश्वमित्रो महामुनिः ॥१-४८-१४॥
verses.transliteration: tat śrutā rāghaveṇa uktam vākyam vākya viśāradaḥ ।prati uvāca mahātejā viśvamitro mahāmuniḥ ॥1-48-14॥

translations.english: "O Descendant of the Raghus I shall tell all you about this hermitage cursed by the wrath of a great man.

verses.sloka: हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि शृणु तत्त्वेन राघव ।यस्य एतत् आश्रम पदम् शप्तम् कोपान् महात्मना ॥१-४८-१५॥
verses.transliteration: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇu tattvena rāghava ।yasya etat āśrama padam śaptam kopān mahātmanā ॥1-48-15॥

translations.english: O Best among men this hermitage resembling a celestial retreat and wellhonoured even by devatas once belonged to illustrious Gautama.

verses.sloka: गौतमस्य नरश्रेष्ठ पूर्वम् आसीत् महात्मनः ।आश्रमो दिव्य संकाशः सुरैः अपि सुपूजितः ॥१-४८-१६॥
verses.transliteration: gautamasya naraśreṣṭha pūrvam āsīt mahātmanaḥ ।āśramo divya saṁkāśaḥ suraiḥ api supūjitaḥ ॥1-48-16॥

translations.english: O Highly renowned prince it was here in ancient times that Gautama in the company of Ahalya practised austerities for several years.
translations.hindi: तथापि उसके साथ तुम तीनों लोकों को विजय कर राज्य सुख भोगोगे । तुम किसी बात की चिन्ता मत करो। «दिति ने इस प्रकार इन्द्र से कहा और इतने में दोपहर हो गई

verses.sloka: स च अत्र तप आतिष्ठत् अहल्या सहितः पुरा ।वर्ष पूगानि अनेकानि राजपुत्र महायशः ॥१-४८-१७॥
verses.transliteration: sa ca atra tapa ātiṣṭhat ahalyā sahitaḥ purā ।varṣa pūgāni anekāni rājaputra mahāyaśaḥ ॥1-48-17॥

translations.english: The thousandeyed Indra, consort of Sachi, having found an opportunity (during the absence of the ascetic), assumed the guise of the ascetic (Gautama) and said to Ahalya:
translations.hindi: दिति को नींद आ गई और वह पैताने की ओर सिर कर उल्टी सो गई । उसको सिरहाने की ओर पैर और पैताने की ओर सिर किए सोती हुई अपवित्र दशा में देख, इन्द्र बहुत प्रसन्न हुए ओर हॅसे । फिर वे उसके शरा! में घुस गए

verses.sloka: तस्य अन्तरम् विदित्वा तु सहस्राक्षः शची पतिः ।मुनि वेष धरो भूत्वा अहल्याम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-४८-१८॥
verses.transliteration: tasya antaram viditvā tu sahasrākṣaḥ śacī patiḥ ।muni veṣa dharo bhūtvā ahalyām idam abravīt ॥1-48-18॥

translations.english: 'O most beautiful one those overtaken by passion would not await the completion of the menstrual period (favourable for copulation). O woman of fine waist I desire union with you.'

verses.sloka: ऋतु कालम् प्रतीक्षन्ते न अर्थिनः सुसमाहिते ।संगमम् तु अहम् इच्छामि त्वया सह सुमध्यमे ॥१-४८-१९॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtu kālam pratīkṣante na arthinaḥ susamāhite ।saṁgamam tu aham icchāmi tvayā saha sumadhyame ॥1-48-19॥

translations.english: O Delight of the Raghus the evilintentioned Ahalya, inclined towards the king of the celestials and knowing him to be the thousandeyed Indra in the guise of the ascetic, consented for the union.

verses.sloka: मुनि वेषम् सहस्राक्षम् विज्ञाय रघुनंदन ।मतिम् चकार दुर्मेधा देव राज कुतूहलात् ॥१-४८-२०॥
verses.transliteration: muni veṣam sahasrākṣam vijñāya raghunaṁdana ।matim cakāra durmedhā deva rāja kutūhalāt ॥1-48-20॥

translations.english: O Foremost of men with her heart's desire fulfilled, Ahalya said: "O Chief of the celestials I'm satisfied. O Lord, quit this place: O Lord of cthe gods, protect yourself and also me from Gautama in all respects."
translations.hindi: इस पर गर्भस्थ बालक जब रोने लगा तब दिति की नींद टूटी । इन्द्र ने गभेस्थ बालक से कहा, मत रो, मत रो

verses.sloka: अथ अब्रवीत् सुरश्रेष्ठम् कृतार्थेन अंतरात्मना ।कृतार्था अस्मि सुरश्रेष्ठ गच्छ शीघ्रम् इतः प्रभो ॥१-४८-२१॥
verses.transliteration: atha abravīt suraśreṣṭham kṛtārthena aṁtarātmanā ।kṛtārthā asmi suraśreṣṭha gaccha śīghram itaḥ prabho ॥1-48-21॥

translations.english: O Foremost of men with her heart's desire fulfilled, Ahalya said: "O Chief of the celestials I'm satisfied. O Lord, quit this place: O Lord of cthe gods, protect yourself and also me from Gautama in all respects."
translations.hindi: इन्द्र रोते हुए बालक को भी पुनः काटने लगे । तब दिति इन्द्र से कहने लगी--अरे मत मारो ! मत मारो !!

verses.sloka: आत्मानम् माम् च देवेश सर्वदा रक्ष गौतमात् ।इन्द्रः तु प्रहसन् वाक्यम् अहल्याम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-४८-२२॥
verses.transliteration: ātmānam mām ca deveśa sarvadā rakṣa gautamāt ।indraḥ tu prahasan vākyam ahalyām idam abravīt ॥1-48-22॥

translations.english: Indra smilingly said to Ahalya, 'O One with lovely hips, I am gratified. I shall go away the way I have come'.

verses.sloka: सुश्रोणि परितुष्टो अस्मि गमिष्यामि यथा आगतम् ।एवम् संगम्य तु तया निश्चक्राम उटजात् ततः ॥१-४८-२३॥
verses.transliteration: suśroṇi parituṣṭo asmi gamiṣyāmi yathā āgatam ।evam saṁgamya tu tayā niścakrāma uṭajāt tataḥ ॥1-48-23॥

translations.english: O Rama he (Indra) came out of the leafhut quickly after his union with her, apprehensive of Gautama.
translations.hindi: इससे तु अशुचि हो गई । इस अवसर को पा, मैंने युद्ध में अपने मारने वाले के सात टुकड़े कर डाले | इसके लिए तू मुझे क्षमा कर दे

verses.sloka: स संभ्रमात् त्वरन् राम शन्कितो गौतमम् प्रति ।गौतमम् स ददर्श अथ प्रविशंतम् महामुनिम् ॥१-४८-२४॥
verses.transliteration: sa saṁbhramāt tvaran rāma śankito gautamam prati ।gautamam sa dadarśa atha praviśaṁtam mahāmunim ॥1-48-24॥

translations.english: Subsequently, Indra beheld the great ascetic Gautama, unassailable by devatas and danavas, endowed with the power of ascetism, drenched with sacrifical waters, shining like flaming fire, carrying sacrificial firewood and Kusha grass and preeminent among sages, entering that leaf hut.

verses.sloka: देव दानव दुर्धर्षम् तपो बल समन्वितम् ।तीर्थ उदक परिक्लिन्नम् दीप्यमानम् इव अनलम् ॥१-४८-२५॥
verses.transliteration: deva dānava durdharṣam tapo bala samanvitam ।tīrtha udaka pariklinnam dīpyamānam iva analam ॥1-48-25॥

translations.english: Subsequently, Indra beheld the great ascetic Gautama, unassailable by devatas and danavas, endowed with the power of ascetism, drenched with sacrifical waters, shining like flaming fire, carrying sacrificial firewood and Kusha grass and preeminent among sages, entering that leaf hut.

verses.sloka: गृहीत समिधम् तत्र स कुशम् मुनि पुंगवम् ।दृष्ट्वा सुर पतिः त्रस्तो विषण्ण वदनो अभवत् ॥१-४८-२६॥
verses.transliteration: gṛhīta samidham tatra sa kuśam muni puṁgavam ।dṛṣṭvā sura patiḥ trasto viṣaṇṇa vadano abhavat ॥1-48-26॥

translations.english: On seeing him, the face of the Lord of the gods (Indra) turned pale with fear. Having seen the wicked Indra with a thousandeyed in the guise of an ascetic the gentle sage Gautama got enraged and said:

verses.sloka: अथ दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षम् मुनि वेष धरम् मुनिः ।दुर्वृत्तम् वृत्त संपन्नो रोषात् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-४८-२७॥
verses.transliteration: atha dṛṣṭvā sahasrākṣam muni veṣa dharam muniḥ ।durvṛttam vṛtta saṁpanno roṣāt vacanam abravīt ॥1-48-27॥

translations.english: "O Wicked natured one assuming my form you have done a forbidden act. For that reason you shall be devoid of scrotum.

verses.sloka: मम रूपम् समास्थाय कृतवान् असि दुर्मते ।अकर्तव्यम् इदम् यस्मात् विफलः त्वम् भविष्यति ॥१-४८-२८॥
verses.transliteration: mama rūpam samāsthāya kṛtavān asi durmate ।akartavyam idam yasmāt viphalaḥ tvam bhaviṣyati ॥1-48-28॥

translations.english: Cursed thus out of anger by eminent Gautama the testicles of Indra immediately dropped down on the earth.

verses.sloka: गौतमेन एवम् उक्तस्य स रोषेण महात्मना ।पेततुः वृषणौ भूमौ सहस्राक्षस्य तत् क्षणात् ॥१-४८-२९॥
verses.transliteration: gautamena evam uktasya sa roṣeṇa mahātmanā ।petatuḥ vṛṣaṇau bhūmau sahasrākṣasya tat kṣaṇāt ॥1-48-29॥

translations.english: Having thus cursed Indra, he also cursed Ahalya: 'You will be staying here for thousands of years without food and subsisting on air, lying down in ashes, doing penance, without being seen by any living beings in this ashrama'.

verses.sloka: तथा शप्त्वा च वै शक्रम् भार्याम् अपि च शप्तवान् ।इह वर्ष सहस्राणि बहूनि निवषिस्यसि ॥१-४८-३०॥
verses.transliteration: tathā śaptvā ca vai śakram bhāryām api ca śaptavān ।iha varṣa sahasrāṇi bahūni nivaṣisyasi ॥1-48-30॥

translations.english: Having thus cursed Indra, he also cursed Ahalya: 'You will be staying here for thousands of years without food and subsisting on air, lying down in ashes, doing penance, without being seen by any living beings in this ashrama'.

verses.sloka: वायु भक्षा निराहारा तप्यन्ती भस्म शायिनी ।अदृश्या सर्व भूतानाम् आश्रमे अस्मिन् वषिस्यसि ॥१-४८-३१॥
verses.transliteration: vāyu bhakṣā nirāhārā tapyantī bhasma śāyinī ।adṛśyā sarva bhūtānām āśrame asmin vaṣisyasi ॥1-48-31॥

translations.english: 'When the son of Dasaratha, the unassailable Rama enters this dreadful forest, you will be cleansed (of this sin)'.

verses.sloka: यदा तु एतत् वनम् घोरम् रामो दशरथ आत्मजः ।आगमिष्यति दुर्धर्षः तदा पूता भविष्यसि ॥१-४८-३२॥
verses.transliteration: yadā tu etat vanam ghoram rāmo daśaratha ātmajaḥ ।āgamiṣyati durdharṣaḥ tadā pūtā bhaviṣyasi ॥1-48-32॥

translations.english: 'O Wickednatured one by offering hospitality to Rama, without covetousness and passion, you will happily live with me by regaining your present form'.

verses.sloka: तस्य आतिथ्येन दुर्वृत्ते लोभ मोह विवर्जिता ।मत् सकाशे मुदा युक्ता स्वम् वपुः धारयिष्यसि ॥१-४८-३३॥
verses.transliteration: tasya ātithyena durvṛtte lobha moha vivarjitā ।mat sakāśe mudā yuktā svam vapuḥ dhārayiṣyasi ॥1-48-33॥

translations.english: "Highly powerful Gautama who had performed rigid austerities thus cursed the wicked Ahalya and left this hermitage, for the peaks of Himavat mountain served by siddhas and charanas. Here he performed austerities"(said Viswamitra). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे अष्टचत्वारिंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fortyeighth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा महातेजा गौतमो दुष्ट चारिणीम् ।इमम् आश्रमम् उत्सृज्य सिद्ध चारण सेविते ।हिमवत् शिखरे रम्ये तपः तेपे महातपाः ॥१-४८-३४॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā mahātejā gautamo duṣṭa cāriṇīm ।imam āśramam utsṛjya siddha cāraṇa sevite ।himavat śikhare ramye tapaḥ tepe mahātapāḥ ॥1-48-34॥
